title: Birds and small animals outdoors
caption: Pigeons, sparrows, crows, gulls, island cats, butterflies and red dragonflies in the outdoor places, by time of day; flocks scatter when Eric walks up. Sparrows and wind by day, crickets after work.

sections.caption: Walk up to a flock and it takes off.

sections.title: Fountain plaza

sections.title: East coast
